summary:
Full backend + frontend E2E for CFO. Backend: 24/24 pytest tests pass (health, all 3 presets, simulate for each preset with default params <5s, emergent bottlenecks, persistence, invalid venue 404, out-of-range 422, custom layout upload + simulate, malformed layouts 422, reroute suggestions AI + fallback + empty + out-of-range 422). HF Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct integration verified end-to-end: source='ai', model='Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct', ~1.1s, real operator recommendation naming location + reroute path. Frontend: all requested flows work - stadium auto-select, preset switching (train_station, festival_ground), Run Simulation fills KPI strip (People 2309, Peak 100%, Critical 2, Clearance 32 min), AI Reroutes panel populates with HF AI badge + severity, suggestion card click draws highlighted alternate path (blue dashed), time scrubber label changes on step and play (22:20 -> 22:23 -> 22:26), 1x/2x/4x + step back/forward all work, comparison card appears on rerun (140 -> 58 events), advanced toggle reveals start-time + duration, malformed JSON toast 'File is not valid JSON', semantic invalid layout toast surfaces backend 422 detail, panel collapse/expand OK, color legend shows all 4 states with patterns. AI features loaded: ai-testing-core, ai-testing-llm.

AI feature verdict: reroute-suggestions (HF Qwen2.5) - pass - evidence: source='ai' model='Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct' elapsed=1.13s text='Re-route fans from Concourse C to Concourse B, then through Turnstile Bank North to Exit Plaza 1. Increase staff at Turnstile Bank North to expedite egress.' (via pytest TestReroute::test_ai_suggestions_with_bottleneck).

issues: Canvas2D warning in console: 'Multiple readback operations using getImageData are faster with willReadFrequently attribute set to true.' Cosmetic only - consider adding {willReadFrequently:true} when getContext('2d') is called.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI on_event('startup'/'shutdown') - consider lifespan handlers (FastAPI >=0.93).
Consider passing willReadFrequently:true on the 2D canvas context to suppress the browser perf warning (VenueCanvas.jsx).
AsyncInferenceClient is instantiated per call (_client_for) and closed each time; ok functionally but a shared client would reduce connection overhead. Not blocking.
seed_data_creation: None persisted beyond pytest custom_* venues used for upload+simulate; MongoDB collections are venues + simulations. Cleanup not implemented but each test creates one small venue only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and loads REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env at import time. Run with `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -v`. All 24 tests pass. Frontend was tested via the public preview URL. Notable: (1) the Run Simulation button auto-switches to the AI Reroutes tab, so to see the comparison-card you must switch back to tab-scenario; (2) simStore setResult uses previous result as previousRun regardless of param changes, so comparison card shows on the 2nd+ run always; (3) preset default params include arrival_curve+event_start_time but not duration_steps for some presets, so App.js merges step_duration_seconds=60 - do not remove that. HF_TOKEN currently in backend/.env is live and working.
